concepts.name: evidence, pushback, and mutation safety
concepts.reason: The universal rules survive without personal role, style, or runtime assumptions.

concepts.name: personal tutor persona and production defaults
concepts.reason: Personal teaching and product preferences belong in a private profile or project overlay.

concepts.name: long-session checkpoints and continuation state
concepts.reason: Verified continuation state remains useful across runtimes.

concepts.name: mode-prefix precedence
concepts.reason: Explicit user instructions and selected workflows replace a private prefix grammar.

concepts.name: stack and product-specific rules
concepts.reason: Reusable overlays and project rules replace one monolithic stack template.

concepts.name: durable project patterns
concepts.reason: Projects still record stable boundaries and conventions near their source.

concepts.name: portable project adoption
concepts.reason: Four adoption levels replace a single personal setup checklist.

concepts.name: duplicated runtime pointer files
concepts.reason: The historical pointers explain migration but no longer define canonical policy.

concepts.name: layering and operating guidance
concepts.reason: The architecture guide now separates canonical sources, profiles, overlays, adapters, and generated state.

concepts.name: routine automatic commits
concepts.reason: A completed task or test pass does not grant Git mutation authority.
